description: IC-LoRA that generates an alpha matte from an RGB clip - no green screen, mask or prompt; handles hair, smoke, fire and glass. The RGB clip is the reference video; the prompt must be empty. Output is a grayscale matte video (white foreground) aligned frame-for-frame, to be combined with the source RGB for compositing. A 0.9 preview weight; up to 145 frames (8n+1) at up to 1920x1088, stage-1 only at native size
use_when: Pull a matte to cut a subject out of a clip for compositing
